draft.title: Missing derivatives of a thin singular value decomposition
draft.body:
## Reproducer

Run this example

```sh
cat > thin-svd.mlir <<'MLIR'
func.func @vals(%a: tensor<4x3xf32>) -> tensor<3xf32> {
  %r:4 = enzymexla.linalg.svd %a : (tensor<4x3xf32>) -> (tensor<4x3xf32>, tensor<3xf32>, tensor<3x3xf32>, tensor<i32>)
  return %r#1 : tensor<3xf32>
}
MLIR
enzymexlamlir-opt thin-svd.mlir --enzyme-wrap='infn=vals outfn= retTys=enzyme_active argTys=enzyme_active mode=ReverseModeCombined'
```

## Observed

The upstream base used by the stack has no adjoint for the SVD operation.

## Expected

For distinct, nonzero singular values and output cotangent g, the real input adjoint should be U diag(g) Vᵀ.

## Proposed fix

Define forward and reverse rules for the thin SVD, reusing the primal factors and handling rectangular shapes. Phase-dependent complex objectives need separate treatment. The upstream reverse proposal is [#2551](https://github.com/EnzymeAD/Enzyme-JAX/pull/2551); the fork rules were described in [#3277](https://github.com/EnzymeAD/Enzyme-JAX/pull/3277).

problems.title: A nested floating-point conversion can lose its rounding step
problems.summary: A round trip from f64 through f32 and back must preserve the rounded value. The pin checks intermediate width. PR #3345 adds a stricter guard for precision, exponent range and supported formats.

commits.title: EnzymeHLOOpt: a conversion that rounds is not folded away
convertconvert.mlir: a conversion that rounds is kept

fix.why_together: The implementation guards the fold; the second commit corrects the existing conversion fixture to require observable rounding.

fix.why_together: The initial rewrite and its four corrections cover counts, exponent representation, reducer types and the final FileCheck pattern.

problems.title: Reshape/slice compiler rewrites can loop indefinitely
problems.summary: When a reshape inserts a unit dimension before a dimension that cannot be removed, a failed rewrite leaves a constant behind. The greedy rewrite driver repeatedly retries it. The upstream change delays creating constants until all matching checks pass. The retained stack lists the local patch as superseded by that change.

commits.title: EnzymeHLOOpt: fix transformReshapeSlice backtracking index and add reshape slice/DUS tests (#3295)

fix.why_together: The pinned base already contains the upstream resolution. This upstream commit is reachable on the fork and carries the replacement used by the retained stack.
